question: Which chapter of the radiant Kashyapa scripture concludes with the rules on pavilion characteristics?
premises: The text refers to the radiant Kashyapa scripture.
The chapter concerns rules on pavilion characteristics.
inference: The forty-third chapter on pavilion characteristics concludes in the radiant Kashyapa scripture.
plain_english: Thus ends the forty-third chapter, on the rules for the characteristics of the pavilion, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
